Mechanism: triple-key-quorum
How: enforce a cap of two concurrent keys per operator. Ten fake identities divided by the cap equals five, limiting live hands to five rather than ten.
Cost: identity n costs 50 plus 10 times n tokens. The third required seed, a karst layer, filters noise while pigment marks failures and an echo confirms sync.
Check: verify unique keys via duplicate detection, not task accuracy, ensuring distinct human presence.
